prompts.title: Add to BAG — propose capture plan
prompts.text: Use the addbag skill on the available history of this session. Identify reusable decisions, methods, tools and components, search BAG for duplicates, and propose a concise ranked capture plan with destinations and evidence. Do not edit the repository before my approval.

prompts.title: Approve capture and autonomous merge
prompts.text: I approve the addbag capture plan just presented (approved items only). Implement it in tbachir/bag on a branch, self-review the changes, fix CI and review findings, and merge its PR when required repository checks pass. Do not ask me for a second discretionary review; report blockers instead.
